errors.text_span: sie liegt zu Beginn bei rund 35.000 (2012/2013)
errors.evidence: The line for 'Haupterwerb Insgesamt' starts at approximately 36,000 Euro in 2012/2013, not 35,000 as stated. The data point is visibly above the midpoint between 30,000 and 40,000.
The line style for 'Haupterwerb Größere' is described as 'punktiert/kurz gestrichelt' (dotted/short-dashed). The line in the plot and legend consists of short dashes, not dots ('punktiert').

errors.text_span: „Haupterwerb Kleinere“ ist hellblau und gestrichelt; [...] „Haupterwerb Mittlere“ ist mittelblau und gestrichelt
errors.evidence: The description uses the same word 'gestrichelt' (dashed) for the lines 'Haupterwerb Kleinere' and 'Haupterwerb Mittlere', failing to differentiate between their distinct dash patterns (long dashes vs. medium dashes), which are clearly different in the legend.
